title: A DFT/TD-DFT investigation of clozapine adsorption on B12Y12 (Y = N, P) nanocages as vehicles for applications in schizophrenia treatment
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22661-22670
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02752G, Paper
Open Access

Charly Tedjeuguim Tsapi, Stanley Numbonui Tasheh, Aymard Didier Tamafo Fouegue, Numbonui Angela Beri, Caryne Isabelle Lekeufack Alongamo, Emmanuel Dassi Atongo, Julius Numbonui Ghogomu
DFT studies show strong clozapine adsorption (−39.96 to −22.05 kcal mol−1), band gap reduction (≤42.7%) and tunable release – enabling targeted schizophrenia therapy and sensing.
